question: Which chapter of the Merutantra concludes with the description of Viṣṇu’s śakti-mantra?
premises: The text is the Merutantra composed by Śiva.
It is approved by Śrī Mahāmāyā and Mahākāla.
The topic is the description of Viṣṇu’s śakti-mantra.
inference: Thus ends the thirtieth chapter, named the description of Viṣṇu’s śakti-mantra, in the Merutantra.
plain_english: Thus, in the Merutantra composed by Śiva and approved by Śrī Mahāmāyā and Mahākāla, ends the thirtieth chapter named the description of Viṣṇu’s śakti-mantra.
